wire.t: YourMomsDildo was the biggest spender on Wednesday waivers: $11 on Emari Demercado (dropping Devin Singletary) and $5 on Cam Ward, who cost A.J. Brown his roster spot. Brown left the Patriots' Week 10 game in Munich with a hamstring injury, and New England is on its Week 11 bye.

ChuckJ10 won the Denver defense for $5, beating claims from ClaytonBigsbi ($1) and Marco_Polo. PickensMyPukaHurts! dropped the Browns defense, which is on bye, and Tank Bigsby, then added Cade Otton Wednesday morning with Kyle Pitts Sr. on bye.
Drake Maye is out indefinitely with his right ankle injury, according to an AP source. C.J. Stroud starts for McCallyCockin(his butt) against MarcusbetterLockNjigba, which is a 21.3-point underdog.

As of Wednesday morning, Rome Alone has four empty lineup slots, including quarterback, plus Corey Kiner and the Rams defense starting on byes. Marco_Polo dropped Bryce Young and Darren Waller on Tuesday and claimed Seth McGowan, Mack Hollins, Michael Mayer and the Detroit defense, none of which are in the lineup yet.
ClaytonBigsbi paid $8 for Chimere Dike and dropped Austin Ekeler. Skatabooboo also swapped the Baltimore defense for Carolina's and Devaughn Vele for Chris Godwin Jr. on Wednesday morning.
RedDevil904 claimed the Bears defense for $2 with the Seahawks on bye and dropped Jacoby Brissett. Shootyeah picked up Brevyn Spann-Ford for Jahan Dotson, with Tucker Kraft on bye.

Six NFL teams are off in Week 11: the Falcons, Browns, Packers, Rams, Patriots and Seahawks. It's the biggest bye group of the season, and YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s loses Bijan Robinson, Harold Fannin Jr., Christian Watson and DeMario Douglas to it all at once. MarcusbetterLockNjigba loses Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Cooper Kupp and Drew Lock to the Seattle bye.

Brock Bowers hurt his ankle in the first quarter against Seattle in Week 10, came back into the game and finished with 3.8 for MarcusbetterLockNjigba. Check the Raiders' Week 11 practice reports before Sunday.

stories.title: Waiver Wednesday: YourMomsDildo cuts A.J. Brown, ChuckJ10 wins the Denver defense, and Rome Alone has four empty lineup slots
stories.dek: $31 spent, three teams chasing the same defense, and Marco_Polo, fresh off the can, still hasn't set a lineup.
body: Waivers ran overnight and $31 changed hands. YourMomsDildo spent more than half of it: $11 on Emari Demercado and $5 on Cam Ward. Cam Ward is starting at quarterback for YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s this week, and the roster spot came from A.J. Brown, who left Week 10 with a hamstring injury and is on the New England bye. With Bijan Robinson, Harold Fannin Jr., Christian Watson and DeMario Douglas all off, YourMomsDildo needed bodies, and now has them.

The Denver defense was the hot item. ChuckJ10 put in $5, ClaytonBigsbi put in $1 and Marco_Polo put in $0, and PickensMyPukaHurts! won it. ChuckJ10 also added Cade Otton for the Kyle Pitts Sr. bye. ClaytonBigsbi settled for the Carolina defense, Chimere Dike ($8) and Chris Godwin Jr. RedDevil904 grabbed the Bears defense for $2.

Then there's Rome Alone. Marco_Polo dropped Bryce Young and Darren Waller on Tuesday and claimed Seth McGowan, Mack Hollins, Michael Mayer and the Detroit defense. As of Wednesday morning, none of them are in the lineup. Four slots are empty, quarterback included, and Corey Kiner and the Rams defense are starting on byes. Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland are all back and all on the bench. It's the Matchup of the Week against I Pulled My McCaff, Rome Alone is a 15.1-point underdog with a full lineup, and Marco_Polo just drank a can for starting zeros.

My own news is worse than it looks on paper: Drake Maye is out indefinitely, so C.J. Stroud is my quarterback for the foreseeable future. McCallyCockin(his butt) is still a 21.3-point favorite over MarcusbetterLockNjigba. Also, full disclosure, Maye was still in my starting lineup when I checked this morning. I'm fixing it before I hit publish on the next one.

stories.title: Week 10: PickensMyPukaHurts! beats me on Monday night, Your Mom’s Magic Dick hits 158.16, and Marco_Polo owes the can
stories.dek: George Pickens scores 43.5, I Pulled My McCaff posts the high score at 159.96, Skatabooboo falls to 0‑10, and Rome Alone scores 71.60 for the shotgun.
body: Monday night went the way ChuckJ10 needed it to. PickensMyPukaHurts! trailed me by 13.20 going in, and Derrick Henry (19.0) and Zay Flowers (11.4) turned that into a 146.12 to 128.92 win. George Pickens had 43.5, the best receiver score of the week, which also makes ChuckJ10 the Week 10 payout winner. Dak Prescott added 34.42. That's 77.92 from one Cowboys stack.

My side of it: Drake Maye got hurt in the first quarter of the Munich game and finished with 3.02, and C.J. Stroud scored 20.44 on my bench. Nobody could have swapped that, so I'm not crying about it. What I can cry about is Mark Andrews (16.2) on the bench behind Brenton Strange (8.9). McCallyCockin(his butt) is 6‑4 and fifth.

Your Mom’s Magic Dick needed 1.57 from Omarion Hampton and got 17.5, so Cavemanfsu beat Likely Cookin That Diaper 158.16 to 142.22, its best score of the year and a third straight win. DuvalTiliFall started Kyren Williams (5.2) with Tony Pollard (23.9) on the bench, and Pollard in that spot wins the game. Likely Cookin That Diaper is 7‑3 and has lost two straight.

The Baltimore defense scored 4.0 for Skatabooboo, which needed 17.63, so ClaytonBigsbi is 0‑10. And the can goes to Marco_Polo: Rome Alone scored 71.60 with two inactive receivers in the lineup and lost to Drew Lock. Shotgun it and post the video. Week 11 is the biggest bye week of the year, and the picks are up.

columns.title: Marco_Polo drank the can. Then he left four lineup slots empty.
columns.dek: Rome Alone is sixth, 62 percent to make the playoffs, and playing the Matchup of the Week with a lineup that isn't there.
body: I want to be fair to Marco_Polo, so let's start with what he did right this week. He worked the wire. He dropped Bryce Young and Darren Waller on Tuesday and claimed Seth McGowan, Mack Hollins, Michael Mayer and the Detroit defense overnight. That's a manager who's paying attention.

Now here's the Rome Alone lineup as of Wednesday morning. Quarterback: empty. Three more slots: empty. Corey Kiner at running back, on a bye. The Rams defense, on a bye. Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland are back from their byes and sitting on the bench, next to all four of the new guys.

Word around the building is Ashton Jeanty has quietly taken over lineup duties at Rome Alone and is tired of being the only starter with a pulse and a game. He reportedly wants a locker-room vibe where the coach shows up before kickoff, and he's been seen leaving the Seth McGowan welcome basket on the bench where everybody else is.

This is the Matchup of the Week. I Pulled My McCaff is favored by 15.1 against a full Rome Alone lineup, and Your Mom’s Magic Dick is right behind at 43 percent waiting for Marco_Polo to fumble the sixth seed. He has until Thursday night. Marco_Polo, you just shotgunned a beer for this exact thing. SET THE LINEUP BEFORE YOU NEED A SECOND CAN!

body: Put on the tape. Week 10. Likely Cookin That Diaper against Your Mom’s Magic Dick. Final, 158.16 to 142.22.
Quarterback: Patrick Mahomes, 36.42. A. Tight end: Isaiah Likely, 28.7. A. James Cook III, 22.7. B-plus. Drake London, 16.9. B. Travis Kelce, 5.0. D.
Running back two. Kyren Williams. 5.2 points. Tony Pollard on the bench with 23.9. That's an 18.7-point swing. They lost by 15.94. Do the math. I did. It's a win.

Sources say Tony Pollard has asked DuvalTiliFall for a trade to any team that will actually start him. Word around the facility is he's been seen studying the McCallyCockin(his butt) depth chart. He likes the vibe over there.

Two straight losses for a 7‑3 team. Still 98 percent to make it. But the bye went from a lock to 44 percent. Week 11: Slippery Balls, with London, Kyren Williams and Kaleb Johnson on byes. Start Pollard. Final grade for Week 10: D.

columns.title: Byemageddon survival guide: five moves for the biggest bye week of the year
columns.dek: Six teams are off. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s loses four starters. Here is what you do, in order.
body: Six teams are on bye in Week 11: the Falcons, Browns, Packers, Rams, Patriots and Seahawks. As your Senior Fantasy Strategist, I have prepared a plan. Follow it exactly.

1. If your best player is on bye, start him anyway. Bijan Robinson scored 17.7 last week. Zero is only 17.7 less than that, which is a rounding error in a league where Rome Alone scored 71.60. YourMomsDildo should keep Bijan Robinson in the lineup out of respect.

2. Trade for players on bye now, while they're cheap. Nobody wants Jaxon Smith-Njigba this week. That's when you buy. tballsmccall should be selling him to MarcusbetterLockNjigba, which is his own team, so he'd be buying low from himself. Arbitrage.
3. Pick up a kicker. This league doesn't start kickers. That's exactly why nobody will see it coming.

I have it on good authority that Bijan Robinson is planning to spend his bye week writing YourMomsDildo a thank-you card for naming YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s after him. He's reportedly on his fourth draft because he can't decide where the apostrophe goes either.

4. Start your entire bench in the FLEX, one at a time, until one of them scores. 5. If none of this works, you are Skatabooboo. In conclusion: PickensMyPukaHurts! vs. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s is a 0.4-point game, and I'm taking the team with more players on bye, because they're rested.

columns.title: Waiver Wednesday by the numbers: $31 spent, and YourMomsDildo is 51.6 percent of the economy
columns.dek: Plus: the Denver defense went for $5, which my model says makes it the most valuable asset in the league.
body: Five winning claims cost money on Wednesday: $11 for Emari Demercado, $8 for Chimere Dike, $5 for Cam Ward, $5 for the Denver defense and $2 for the Bears defense. That's $31. YourMomsDildo spent $16 of it, or 51.6 percent. By my model, YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s now controls the league's money supply and should be setting interest rates.

The Denver defense drew three claims: ChuckJ10 at $5, ClaytonBigsbi at $1 and Marco_Polo at $0. ChuckJ10 won. Five dollars is 2.5 times the Bears defense and 5 times what ClaytonBigsbi offered, which means PickensMyPukaHurts! now owns the most valuable asset in the league. Ahead of George Pickens. The math is the math.

Marco_Polo made four claims at $0 and won three of them, plus the Detroit defense. That's four free players for $0, an infinite return on investment. My model gives Rome Alone the best waiver efficiency in league history. It also notes four empty lineup slots, which I've classified as cash reserves.

I'm told Cam Ward has asked YourMomsDildo for a team rename now that he's the starting quarterback, on the grounds that YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s already has two apostrophes and none of them are for him. Sources say he's floated adding a third, and the league office is reviewing the punctuation.

Week 11: PickensMyPukaHurts! is a 0.4-point favorite over YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s, the closest game on the board. Erection Projections has ChuckJ10 at 88 percent and YourMomsDildo at 19. My model says the $16 closes the gap. I'm not apologizing for any of this.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: I Pulled My McCaff vs. Rome Alone: the biggest total on the board, and the last playoff spot on the line
items.dek: A 260.6 total, the most points in the league against the team holding the sixth seed, and Marco_Polo still has a can to drink.
body: This is the game with the most points in it. I Pulled My McCaff scores 141.8 a week, the best in the league, with an 86‑24 all-play. Rome Alone scores 118.8 a week. Put them together and the total is 260.6, highest of Week 11 by 10.9.

And it's the one with the stakes. Rome Alone is 6‑4, sixth in the standings and at 62 percent in Erection Projections, the last team inside the line. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is right behind at 43 percent. I Pulled My McCaff is at 96 percent to make it and 46 percent for a bye, so Hing1eMcCring13berry is playing for the top two.

The byes cut both ways. I Pulled My McCaff loses Blake Corum, KC Concepcion Jr. and Dylan Sampson to byes, and Kenneth Walker III is out, so Christian McCaffrey carries the backfield. Rome Alone gets Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland back but loses the Rams defense. That cuts a 23.1-point gap to 15.1.
The pick: I Pulled My McCaff by 15.1, 69 percent. Marco_Polo has the bodies back. Now he has to put them in the lineup.

items.dek: 205.2 projected points combined, 55 below the Matchup of the Week. Skatabooboo has been eliminated for weeks.
body: The sewer game this week is Your Mom’s Magic Dick against Skatabooboo, with a projected total of 205.2, the lowest on the board by 19.0. Skatabooboo scores 85.2 a week, the worst in the league by 15.8, and is 0‑10.

Playoff implications: one side only. Skatabooboo is out. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is 5‑5 at 43 percent, so the only thing that matters here is Cavemanfsu not becoming the answer to a trivia question by losing to the winless team.

Your Mom’s Magic Dick is hot, three straight wins at 149.46 a week, and only loses bench guys (Matthew Stafford, Konata Mumpfield, Denzel Boston) to byes. Skatabooboo gets Courtland Sutton back from his bye but loses Tutu Atwell. Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 last week and is the only reason to watch.
The pick: Your Mom’s Magic Dick by 33.8, 86 percent. ClaytonBigsbi, there's always Week 12.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Allen-tents & Purposes over JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson by 34.1: the biggest spread of Week 11
items.dek: The first-place team, three straight wins and its backups back from byes, against a team at 3 percent.
body: Allen-tents & Purposes scores 140.1 a week with a 79‑31 all-play. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson scores 108.0. That's a 32.1-point gap before anyone checks the injury report.

Then you check it. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson loses Zach Charbonnet to the Seattle bye, and Jaylen Waddle and Jake Ferguson are out. Allen-tents & Purposes loses Matthew Golden and the Seahawks defense but gets Dallas Goedert, Jonah Coleman and D’Andre Swift back from Week 10 byes. That's 34.1.

Stakes: Allen-tents & Purposes is at 84 percent for a bye and wants the top seed. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson is 5‑5 and at 3 percent; it needs to win out and get help. Brock Purdy scored 33.66 last week, and GeorigaGoocher needs another one of those plus a Jahmyr Gibbs dud.
The pick: Allen-tents & Purposes by 34.1, 86 percent. RedDevil904 should be done by Sunday afternoon.
